inboxDescription: Every client request in one inbox: review, accept, ask for details and keep work within its SLA.
portalDescription: Submit new work to the agency and follow each request from brief to delivery.
noTypesTitle: No request types are available yet
noTypesBody: Your agency hasn't published any request types. You can still message your account manager.
searchPlaceholder: Search by title, reference or client
referenceLinksHint: Links to examples, competitors or inspiration.
internalNoteHint: Turn on “Internal note” in the composer to write something the client won't see.
submitted: Request {reference} submitted. We'll be in touch soon.
attachHint: Drag files here or choose up to {max} (images, PDFs, videos, documents).
filesLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No more files} one {# more file} other {# more files}}
formattingHint: Tip: **bold** and lines starting with “- ” become a list.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: A short summary, e.g. “National Day post for Instagram”.

agency.submitted: The request goes back to the queue.
agency.under_review: Let the client know you're looking at it.
agency.needs_info: Ask exactly what you need. The client can update the brief and send it back.
agency.accepted: Work is confirmed; the package item is counted unless the request is extra.
agency.rejected: Explain why so the client knows what to do next.
agency.in_progress: The team is working on it.
agency.delivered: The client is notified that the work is ready.
agency.cancelled: The request is closed without being done.
agency.reopen: Brings the request back into work.
agency.withdraw: Take the question back and continue reviewing.

client.submitted: Send the request to the agency.
client.under_review: Send your updates back to the agency.
client.closed: Confirm you received the work. The request will be closed.
client.cancelled: The agency will stop working on it. You can submit a new request anytime.

reason.question: What do you need from the client?
reason.visibleToClient: The client sees this in the request and in the notification.
reason.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Please share the product photos in high resolution.

flags.extraHint: Outside the package — doesn't use a package item.

needsInfo.title: Update {reference}
needsInfo.description: Answer the agency's question, adjust the brief, and send it back.
needsInfo.bannerBody: Update the brief (or reply in the discussion) to move the request forward.

deliveredBanner.title: Your request was delivered
deliveredBanner.body: Take a look and close the request, or ask for changes in the discussion.

wizard.description: Pick what you need, answer a few questions and we'll take it from there. You can save a draft at any step.
wizard.draftSaved: Draft saved. You can come back to it anytime.
wizard.resubmitted: Thanks — the agency will review your updates.
wizard.typicalTime: Usually delivered in {days, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
wizard.priorityHint: Urgent requests are agreed with your account manager.
wizard.extraAllowed: You can still submit — it will be handled as an extra.

tracker.rejected: This request was rejected. See the history for the reason.
